scope.done_when: pnpm typecheck passa e os diálogos usam só o IF-011

findings.summary: The literal `pnpm typecheck` exits 1 in this environment. pnpm runs its pre-run deps check, which executes `pnpm install`, and the postinstall `prisma migrate deploy` fails with 'SQLite database error: database is locked' on data/fitpulse.db. The Play preview is running on port 3543 (.aioson/preview.json, running=true) and holds that database. tsc never ran in that run. The check body passes: `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false typecheck` exits 0 with empty output. The preview was not stopped because it is shared environment state.

Deferred to integration, not run by this unit: `pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/questionnaireFile.test.ts tests/api/questionnaireRoutes.test.ts` and `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/remoteQuestionnaire.spec.ts tests/e2e/home.spec.ts tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts`. These are outside this unit's Done-when line and were listed by the implementer as integration checks.

The literal wording 'os diálogos usam só o IF-011' is not strictly met: 'Mostrar na pasta' calls filesApi.revealSavedFile (IF-002), with only the file id sent. The implementation plan (implementation-plan-relatorios-e-acompanhamento.md:56,314) specifies this reveal, so it is treated as a wording mismatch in the contract rather than a defect.

The company page fetches the whole consultant home (getConsultantHome) only to show one pending-questionnaire line and swallows its errors. This is a known contract gap (single-company attention endpoint absent), not a functional defect in this unit.

evidence.note: Failed in pnpm's pre-run deps check and postinstall prisma migrate deploy (database is locked); tsc did not run.
Runs `tsc --noEmit` with empty output; this is the unit's typecheck body.

evidence.summary: Grep of src/features for @/api imports, fetch( and the IF-011 symbols. questionnaire dialogs import only questionnaireApi (sendQuestionnaire, importAnswers), httpClient.isApiError and filesApi.revealSavedFile. No fetch( calls. CompanyPage, CompanyTimeline, ConsultantHome and CompaniesPage use homeApi, historyApi, companiesApi and httpClient only.
SendQuestionnaireDialog.tsx:92,113 renders send.message from the IF-011 response (questionnaireApi.ts:13) through the copy hook, so the client text is server-built, not client-built.

messages.text: Run `pnpm typecheck` once the Play preview on port 3543 is stopped, or use `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false typecheck`. The default run fails in postinstall prisma migrate deploy on the locked data/fitpulse.db; the tsc body exits 0. Also run the deferred suites: `pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/questionnaireFile.test.ts tests/api/questionnaireRoutes.test.ts` and `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/remoteQuestionnaire.spec.ts tests/e2e/home.spec.ts tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts`.
